verdict.rationale: Drata's first-party agent has read-only access to system preferences to check settings such as screensaver locking, password manager, antivirus and automatic updates. A community report confirms that employees in the corporate directory show up as noncompliant in the Drata dashboard, and the Devices API supports device records from custom connections. Missing for 10: any evidence that disk encryption is checked, documented MDM integrations, and first-party docs describing the per-employee compliance view.

support.subject: As an IT admin, workstation compliance is tracked per employee — disk encryption, screen lock, password manager — via an agent or MDM integration

citations.quote: This application is granted READ ONLY access to your system preferences to help ensure proper security configurations are set - such as screensaver locking, password manager, antivirus software and automatic updates are enabled.
If you're in the company's corporate directory, you show up as noncompliant in the Drata dashboard.
